data.title: 爱西亚 · 晨光微曦的白被浅眠
data.description: 晨光穿透白纱洒满整张双人床，金发少女安静地侧卧在松软的枕席间。纯白的被褥松松地盖到腰际，露出修长白皙的双肩与锁骨。初醒的爱西亚揉了揉泛着水光的碧绿眼眸，看到床边之人的瞬间，嘴角绽放开宛如春日初蕾般甜美纯净的笑颜，眼角还带着幸福梦境留下的晶莹湿润。
data.location: sun-drenched master bedroom with white linen curtains
data.action: 揉了揉泛着水光的碧绿眼眸，看到床边之人的瞬间，嘴角绽放开宛如春日初蕾般甜美纯净的笑颜
data.lighting: radiant morning sunlight pouring across white linens and golden hair
data.promptProse: Waking softly on her side amid bright white pillows in a sunlit master bedroom, Asia lies with a crisp white sheet draped loosely to her waist over her pale mint lace-ruffled cotton nightdress slipped off her bare shoulders. Raising one hand to rub her sleepy eyes, she brightens into a pure, delighted smile upon noticing the viewer beside the bed as radiant morning sunbeams pour through the white linen curtains.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side with white sheets draped to her waist and her pale mint lace nightdress slipping off her bare shoulders, Asia rubs her sleepy eyes and beams toward the viewer with a radiant morning smile. Bright sunbeams stream across the pillows through white linen curtains.
data.nsfwProse: Lying half-tucked beneath a white sheet draped across her waist, the ruffled neckline of her pale mint cotton nightdress slips loosely off her bare shoulders and collarbone.
